message.content:
You can pay **federal taxes online** through the IRS using **IRS Direct Pay**, an **IRS Online Account**, or the **Electronic Federal Tax Payment System (EFTPS)**.[1][2][3]

- **IRS Direct Pay**: available for individual taxpayers and does not require enrollment.[3][5]
- **IRS Online Account**: lets individuals make payments after creating an account.[1][3]
- **EFTPS**: a free Treasury system for paying IRS taxes online after enrollment; it can also be used by businesses and tax professionals.[1][2][3]

If you want to pay by **credit or debit card**, the IRS also allows card payments through third-party processors, which may charge a fee.[5][7][8]

If you want, I can also give you the **fastest option for an individual**, **business**, or **estimated tax payment**.
